label: Collect board (saved things pile in)
description: A board / collection card that FILLS as things are saved into it: each image flies in from off the card, lands in the next slot, and the count in the corner ticks up ('future home  47 -> 59 elements'). Saving, shown as the thing piling up -- pair it with a line that changes per source ('from the web', 'from your camera roll'). The card fills the component's box. Example: {"title":"future home","count_from":47,"items":[...12 urls],"cols":4,"every":0.3}.

first_at.label: When the first image lands (default at + 0.5)

text_size.label: Header size as a fraction of the card width (default 0.034)
